title: feat(objectql): agent and skill names held per namespace, not per deployment (ADR-0150 child B)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9DW9W3T1oJiUuncBB88cvjk)_

Fixes #31701

Clause-②: yes (widening) — measured on head `db130afb` and base `0cd594b3`: the package door (`SchemaRegistry.installPackage`), the item seam (`SchemaRegistry.registerItem`) and the cold boot's holder seal (`SchemaRegistry.sealBareNameHolders`) accept, for an agent and a skill, a second package holder they refused on base: one that declares a namespace other than the holder's. Nothing is narrowed.
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — no published skill teaches the scope of an agent or skill name; `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` says "Unique skill id" with no scope, which stays true per namespace.

**Narrowing: none.** The card and the claim declared "Narrowing: yes, for co-owners of one namespace (measured first-party: 0)". That narrowing does not happen in this change: a co-owner of one namespace was refused by phase 1 on base and is refused by phase 1 here, with the same refusal. No new refusal is added (seat ruling, claim amendment 6747754224).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:两个不同命名空间的包现在可以各自带一个同名的 agent 或 skill,安装、冷启动都不再拒绝;同一命名空间的两个包、没有命名空间的包、`base/system/sys` 里的两个包、内置名,照旧拒绝,信息不变。
- 为什么改:ADR-0150 D9 规定每种类型在读取方都按(包,名)解析之后,把「全环境一个持有者」收窄为「每个命名空间一个」;agent 和 skill 的读取方(`/meta`、MCP 面名)已在 E8、G2 就位,这是 AI 族的收尾卡。
- 风险与回滚:只放宽，不收紧;裸名读取遇到两个持有者仍返回 409 并列出候选，不会静默取第一个。回滚就是 revert 本 PR,已经装上的跨命名空间同名包在下次安装同名第三包时会重新被拒。
- 先看:`packages/objectql/src/bare-name-one-holder.ts`(`NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` 与 `bareNameHoldersMeet`)、`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`(`bareNameHoldersOtherThan` 与 `sealBareNameHolders` 的过滤)、`packages/objectql/src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts` 的 "the narrowing" 一节。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts`,应看到 60 个测试全绿，其中 "the narrowing" 一节两个命名空间的包都装上、同命名空间与无命名空间的仍被拒。
- 需要你做的:无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The switch.** `bare-name-one-holder.ts` gains `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` (`['agent', 'skill']`) and one predicate, `bareNameHoldersMeet(type, incomingNamespace, holderNamespace)`. A type not in the set always meets (today's behaviour). A type in it meets unless both packages declare a namespace and the two differ. The later B cards (#31696, #31697, #31699, #31700) each add their type to the set, with no other code.
- **The callers.** `SchemaRegistry.bareNameHoldersOtherThan` (asked by the package door, the item seam and the function bind) skips a package holder that does not meet the incoming package. The package door reads the incoming namespace from the manifest; the item seam and the function bind read it from the installed record. `sealBareNameHolders` reports each later holder against the first earlier holder it meets, so for every type outside the set its output is unchanged.
- **Unchanged.** The built-in name refusal (applied before the package filter). The refusal's envelope, code and sentence. The cold-boot switch (`'warn'`). N's namespace rule and its type list. Every reader: `/meta/agent|skill/NAME` still go through `readPackageScopedItem` (E8), MCP prompts through `lookupSkillPrompt` (G2).
- The module doc gains "The narrowing", the reader bullets for agent and skill are put in the past tense, and the ADR anchor for the module names ADR-0150.

## The three positions (epic seat) and the declared narrowing

| Position | Before | After | Pin |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Two packages of two namespaces hold one agent or skill name | refused (422 `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`) | **installed**, boots, no cold-boot warning | registry "two packages of two namespaces…", "the cold boot of two namespaces' holders…"; dogfood boot + install-local `gamma` |
| ① A co-owner of the holder's namespace | refused | refused, same sentence | registry matrix (co-owner rival) + "a co-owner … naming only its own namespace's holder"; dogfood install-local `alphamod` / `alphaext` |
| ② Either package declares no namespace | refused | refused | registry "a package with no namespace is still refused…" (both directions) |
| ③ Two packages of one shareable namespace (`base`, `system`, `sys`) | refused | refused — **not widened**: D2 allows it, nothing asks for it | registry `it.each(['base','system','sys'])` |
| A built-in name | refused | refused | registry "a built-in name is still refused to a package of any namespace" |
| `tool` and every other covered type | refused | refused | registry "CONTROL — a tool has not narrowed", the tool rows of the matrix, and the data, request and flow family files unchanged |

## Forced test changes

- `packages/objectql/src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts`: the matrix's rival package for `agent` and `skill` was a package of another namespace (`beta`), which is now admitted. It becomes a co-owner of `alpha`'s namespace (declares `alpha`, depends on `com.acme.alpha`, its object carries the `alpha_` prefix), so every refusal assertion still runs, with the rename the co-owner gets (`alpha_NAME`). The tool rows keep their old rival. The reason test's second package becomes a co-owner for the same reason.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.dogfood.test.ts`: the cold-boot warning no longer names the agent and the skill (only the tool), and install-local of a third namespace's agent or skill now installs. The two old cases that asserted a 422 for `gamma` (agent) and `delta` (skill) become: a co-owner of `alpha` is refused (422, same sentence), and a third namespace installs. The old helper `skillPromptTitle` picked the first prompt row by name on the test side; it is replaced by `prompts/list` and `prompts/get` over the live MCP transport (G2's real reader).
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/stored-references.integration.test.ts`: packages A and B of the fixture also declare one agent and one skill name in their own namespaces; the existing `sealedClashes` assertion (only the picklist) now also pins that the S4 report no longer lists them.

## Tests

All on head `db130afb`, `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, after a full `turbo run build --filter='./packages/**'` (81/81).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/registry-bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.test.ts` — **60/60** passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test` — **581/581 files, 11978/11978 tests** passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` — exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration src/commands/migrate/stored-references.integration.test.ts` (objectql rebuilt) — **8/8** passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/bare-name-one-holder-ai-family.dogfood.test.ts` (objectql rebuilt) — **7/7** passed.
- `npx eslint --no-inline-config packages/objectql packages/cli packages/qa/dogfood` — exit 0.
- Full dogfood battery: not run — the title carries no `!` and the `Clause-②:` line no `(narrowing)` arm; CI's `Dogfood Regression Gate` runs it in the queue.

<details><summary>Base vs head, in-process: two packages of two namespaces, and a co-owner (probe, not committed)</summary>

On base `0cd594b3`, `com.qa.alpha` (namespace `alpha`) installs; `com.qa.beta` (namespace `beta`, the same agent and skill names) is refused:

```
BareNameConflictError 422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT — Bare-name conflict: package "com.qa.beta" cannot register 2 names another holder already holds — package "com.qa.beta" declares the agent "qa_shared_agent", already held by package "com.qa.alpha" — rename it to "beta_qa_shared_agent" in "com.qa.beta"; package "com.qa.beta" declares the skill "qa_shared_skill", already held by package "com.qa.alpha" — …
```

On head, `com.qa.beta` installs. `com.qa.gamma` (namespace `alpha`, depends on alpha) is refused on base AND on head with the byte-identical sentence:

```
BareNameConflictError 422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT — Bare-name conflict: package "com.qa.gamma" cannot register 2 names another holder already holds — package "com.qa.gamma" declares the agent "qa_shared_agent", already held by package "com.qa.alpha" — rename it to "alpha_qa_shared_agent" in "com.qa.gamma"; … See ADR-0048.
```
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; every restore: blob == HEAD 67f65213, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

Run over the five registry files (ai, data, request and flow families, and N's `registry-namespace-co-owner-names.test.ts`, 244 tests):

1. **Namespace judgement removed** (`bareNameHoldersMeet` returns `true`): 11 failed / 233 — all in the ai-family file: the switch pin, "two packages of two namespaces each install…" (agent, skill), "the item seam admits an installed package of another namespace", "a co-owner … naming only its own namespace's holder", both cold-boot narrowing pins.
2. **Switch widened to every type** (the `isNamespaceScopedBareNameType` guard deleted): 74 failed / 170 — data family 21, request family 16, flow family 29, ai family 8 (the tool rows and "CONTROL — a tool has not narrowed").
3. **A one-sided namespace counted as another namespace** (`!((a || b) && a !== b)`): 7 failed / 237 — "a package with no namespace is still refused…" (agent, skill), the item-seam refusal from a package with no record, the ABLATION matrix rows, the switch pin.
4. **Dogfood, agent meets every holder again** (objectql rebuilt; `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in `dist`, then `--absent` after the restore and rebuild): 3 failed / 7 — the boot warning (now names the agent), the co-owner refusal (now also names beta), the third-namespace install.

Each ablation went red as expected; N's file stayed green under all three (its rule is untouched).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Qualified meta addresses are NOT MEASURED here**: `/meta/:type/:ns/:name` is G1 (#31691), not on `main` yet. The bare door's 409 names both holders by package id, `?package=` serves each package's own, and over MCP the bare skill name is refused naming both faces (`alpha-NAME`, `beta-NAME`), each face serving its own skill.
- **`agent_prompt` is the stdio transport's alone**: the runtime's HTTP MCP bridge registers no `agent_prompt`, so the dogfood file cannot drive it over HTTP. Its faces are pinned in `packages/mcp` (G2).
- Observation, not filed: `packages/lint/src/validate-ai-surface-affinity.ts` keys an artifact's skills by name in a `Map` (the later one wins). It is an authoring diagnostic that serves no item and skips names it cannot resolve; in a `packages[]` artifact whose two packages of two namespaces now hold one skill name, an agent's affinity finding may be judged against the other package's skill.
- The metadata service (`MetadataManager`) keys a multi-package artifact's items by `(type, name)`, so its own copy keeps the later package's agent or skill. Every server reader reads the registry through the protocol; only a host with no protocol falls back to it for `agent_prompt`. This was already true of a deployment that booted with the clash (warn) before this change.
- The refusal's reason sentence for an agent and a skill ("`/meta/agent/NAME` serves one agent per name…") is kept byte-identical (position ①), although after E8 and G2 the readers refuse rather than pick. Rewording it is left out on purpose.

## Verification
